security_spec.violation_condition: Linux kernel (S-mode) accesses acliciprio[k] or aclicsourcecfg[k] CSRs while M-mode firmware has mstateen0[53] (ACLIC) cleared, causing an unexpected illegal instruction trap in kernel context
security_spec.summary: Kernel ACLIC CSR access unconditionally assumes Smstateen mstateen0[53] is set by firmware; a cleared bit causes unhandled illegal-instruction traps
